name: ai.nvim
description: A Neovim plugin for AI agent integration. Provides AI capabilities directly within the Neovim editor environment for seamless AI-assisted development.

name: Agentkodex
description: CLI-native operations platform for coding agents: persistent terminals, signed capabilities, quality gates, audit bundles, scorecards, routing, swarms, and tournaments.

name: DevOps Deployment Gatekeeper
description: AI-powered CI/CD security gate. Automate PR vulnerability scanning, policy enforcement, and blocking critical deployments using crewAI, SonarQube, and Slack integration.

name: Cross-Agent Memory Kit
description: Persistent, self-updating memory for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Kiro, Hermes) with post-session distillation, retrieval skill, optional Cloudflare multi-device sync, multi-user mode, and interactive install wizard.

name: roach-code
description: Config- and plugin-driven terminal AI coding agent supporting multiple models (DeepSeek, Codex/OpenAI, MiniMax, GLM). A multi-model rewrite of deepseek-reasonix, distributed as a single static Go binary with prefix caching for low token costs across long sessions.

name: DMX
description: Official implementation of the AI SDLC — developer workflow orchestration via MCP (Model Context Protocol) for complete development lifecycle automation.

name: inline
description: Inline comments from an AI coding agent to your IDE. Designed for developers who prefer IDE integration over terminal-based AI coding agents or desktop apps.

name: AI-CLI (Web IDE)
description: Run Terminal or AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Aider, etc.) on your phone/tablet — a responsive web IDE with terminal, split-pane editor, file browser, and real-time collaboration capabilities.

name: Darwincode
description: The open source terminal AI coding agent. Build, edit, debug, and run code autonomously from terminal with full repository awareness.

name: Pao
description: macOS-first terminal AI coding agent orchestrator for local AI CLIs with management capabilities for coordinating multiple terminal-based AI agents.

name: TerminalMind
description: Free, open-source, CLI-based AI coding agent that runs on any device. Built with LangChain, RAG, and MCP Protocol. No subscription, no cloud dependency.

name: openclaw-devops-copilot
description: DevOps Copilot: an AI-powered assistant for DevOps workflows, infrastructure as code generation, and SRE tasks. Helps orchestrate complex development operations workflows.

name: Ultracode
description: Local AI-assisted coding CLI inspired by Claude Code. Runs agentic coding workflows with OpenAI-compatible models, function-calling tools, task planning, memory, permissions, hooks, background commands, MCP integration, and subagent support. Features interactive REPL and one-shot modes.

name: Sharrowkin IDE
description: AI IDE with persistent memory and local-first architecture. Features bring-your-own-model support for privacy-conscious developers who want full control over their AI coding environment.

name: Lux IDE
description: Rust-first desktop IDE designed for fast, typed, AI-native developer workflows. Built for performance with modern Rust architecture and AI-first development experience.

name: zero-cost-cline
description: Guide to 100% local, private LLM code generation on Apple Silicon. Optimized for 24GB+ Macs, uses Ollama + Cline to build a disciplined, free agentic workflow with complete local operation.

name: Operon
description: Advanced autonomous AI Terminal Cockpit combining features from OpenClaw and Hermes Agent for autonomous task execution and terminal-based workflow management.

name: MimoAgent
description: AI-powered coding assistant desktop app based on Xiaomi MiMo. Supports code generation, debugging, refactoring, project analysis, MCP tools, and TTS. A comprehensive desktop application for AI-assisted development.

name: WorkFlowX
description: Multi-agent orchestration framework for AI-driven development — from requirement to code to evaluation in one workflow.

name: Self-HealOps
description: AI-powered autonomous DevOps platform that detects CI/CD failures, performs root cause analysis using NVIDIA NIM, generates remediation plans, validates fixes, and creates automated recovery workflows.

name: review-forge
description: An Agent Skill for structured, auditable code review workflows. Provides workflow-specific code review capabilities for AI coding agents with proper audit trails.

name: ai-refactor-playbook-runner
description: Markdown-driven AI refactor playbook runner with CLI and local web UI for executing structured refactoring workflows.

name: gsd-browser
description: A fast, native browser automation CLI built for AI agents, powered by Chrome DevTools Protocol. 63 commands covering navigation, interaction, screenshots, accessibility, network mocking, visual diffing, test generation, and more.

name: Mimo Code
description: CLI coding agent powered by the MiMo large language model for autonomous code editing and development tasks from the terminal.

name: Loushang
description: AI-native coding orchestration platform with unified multi-model agent runtime, stateful sessions, tool governance, and traceable delivery.

name: Cantus
description: A Claude-first, local-first desktop coding environment for macOS (Apple Silicon). Built as a native Tauri 2 app pairing Monaco editor with integrated terminal running Claude Code CLI, per-hunk git staging, resumable sessions, and SQLite-backed memory store. A full IDE alternative to Claude's desktop app.

name: KelvCodes
description: AI-native, lightweight VS Code extension for high-speed code generation, contextual refactoring, and real-time debugging. Powered by OpenRouter with premium and free AI models.

name: IronBee DevTools VSCode
description: VSCode Extension for IronBee DevTools — Verification and Intelligence Layer for AI Coding Agents with safety and verification capabilities.

name: Vantyx AI
description: AI agent runtime and orchestration framework for autonomous workflows, persistent memory, multi-agent systems, observability, and enterprise-grade AI infrastructure.

name: Harbor CLI
description: CLI tool with companion app to spin up complete local LLM stacks. Provides a containerized toolkit for developers to manage local Large Language Model environments and AI coding infrastructure.
